sloka: सा महाअर्णवम् आसाद्य ह्Rष्टा वानर वाहिनी ।त्रिधा निविष्टा महती रामस्यार्थपराभवत् ॥६-४-११०॥।।
transliteration: sā mahāarṇavam āsādya hRṣṭā vānara vāhinī ।tridhā niviṣṭā mahatī rāmasyārthaparābhavat ॥6-4-110॥।।

translations.english: The three army groups of vanaras protected by Sugriva encamped for the purpose of Rama appeared enthusiastic.
